places.quote: A moment, and I occupy my place in the Cathedral, where we all went together, every Sunday morning, assembling first at school for that purpose.
places.note: Identified by context as Canterbury Cathedral; the passage says only 'the Cathedral'.

places.quote: I chiefly wonder what he’ll be, when he leaves Doctor Strong’s, and what mankind will do
places.note: School named after its headmaster; location inferred as Canterbury.

places.quote: Miss Shepherd is a boarder at the Misses Nettingalls’ establishment.
places.note: Girls' boarding school; location inferred as Canterbury.

places.quote: And the little girl I saw on that first day at Mr. Wickfield’s, where is she?
places.note: House of a named person; location inferred as Canterbury.

places.quote: He is the terror of the youth of Canterbury.
